why: A halanta न् before a space is not a Sanskrit form; the vocative पवमान is needed and restores the 8-syllable pada.

line: इन्द्र जुषस्व प्र वहा याहि शूर हरिह ।
why: हरिह is not a recognisable form (vocative of हरि would differ); may be an edition reading or a slip, cannot tell from the lines alone.
पस्यति is a typing slip for पश्यति (स for श).

line: महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्तम मह्ना देव महाँ असि ॥
suggest: महस्ते सतो महिमा पनिष्टम मह्ना देव महाँ असि ॥
why: ष्त is an impossible conjunct in Sanskrit (ष + त must be ष्ट): पनिष्तम should read पनिष्टम.
